broker_info.description: Returns the broker's name, version, uptime, host, port, TLS status, and configured URL paths.

providers_list.description: Returns every provider slot known to the broker (connected and disconnected), with transport kind, `_all` membership, when the provider attached, client count, and pending request count. The counts are the slot's callers, not the provider: a connected provider nobody is calling reads all zeros.

provider_status.description: Returns the status of one provider slot identified by name. Errors if the slot does not exist.

broker_guide.description: Returns the broker's own integration documentation as Markdown: how to publish a provider, how to reach a slot as a client, how to configure an MCP host, how to deploy, and a symptom-to-fix troubleshooting page. Read this instead of looking for a README. Call with no argument for the index.

properties.topic: Which page to return: index, publish-provider, connect-client, host-config, deploy, or troubleshooting. Omit for the index, which says which page to read next.

broker_diagnose.description: Returns the broker's live state plus the problems it can detect about its own wiring, each with the symptom, the evidence, and a concrete fix. Call this first when something does not work: it correlates the counters for you and names the cause.

properties.slot: Narrow the report to one provider slot (case-sensitive). Omit to diagnose the whole broker.

broker://info.name: Broker info
broker://info.description: Broker identity, version, uptime, and listening configuration.

broker://providers.name: Broker providers
broker://providers.description: List of every provider slot known to the broker, including disconnected ones.

broker://guide/index.name: Guide index
broker://guide/index.description: What the broker is, the transport/path pairing rule that costs the most time to get wrong, and which guide page to read next.

broker://guide/publish-provider.name: Guide: publish a provider
broker://guide/publish-provider.description: Put an MCP server into a slot: the transport/path pairing rule, the wire formats, the aggregate opt-in, the connect/register/release lifecycle, and the browser limits.

broker://guide/connect-client.name: Guide: connect a client
broker://guide/connect-client.description: Reach a slot as a client: the four client transports, the reserved _broker and _all slots, the origin check, authorization, and every error code you can receive.

broker://guide/host-config.name: Guide: MCP host configuration
broker://guide/host-config.description: Wire Claude Desktop or another stdio MCP host: why the bridge must target _all, the config recipe, the one-broker-per-port rule, and the anonymous-principal caveat.

broker://guide/deploy.name: Guide: deploy the broker
broker://guide/deploy.description: Embed the broker as a library or run it as a process: startup ordering, topologies, the config file, static files, TLS, and shutdown.

broker://guide/troubleshooting.name: Guide: troubleshooting
broker://guide/troubleshooting.description: Symptom to cause to fix, starting with the silent failures that produce no log line anywhere: hung clients, wedged slots, stale tool lists, blocked origins.

broker://providers/{name}.name: Broker provider
broker://providers/{name}.description: Snapshot of one specific provider slot, addressed by its name.

broker://guide/{topic}.name: Broker guide page
broker://guide/{topic}.description: One page of the broker's integration documentation, addressed by topic: index, publish-provider, connect-client, host-config, deploy, or troubleshooting.
